description: Making AI Work: The Uttar Pradesh government is mandating an 'AI for All' course for vocational training from Classes 9 to 12, aiming to equip over 2 lakh students with essential AI skills for future job opportunities.
body_lead: UP govt makes 'AI for All' course mandatory in all vocational training programmes This initiative, starting in the 2026-27 financial year, will equip over two lakh students with essential AI skills. The four-hour course aims to prepare them for future job opportunities and technological advancements.
